name: Saki Itsuka
source:
Though born in Tokyo, Saki Itsuka and her family moved to London when she was just 3 years old. She is the next-door neighbour of Shuyaku, whom she met, when they were just 
children, one rainy night, at the park, near their houses. 

Ever since she was a child, Saki has always admired the art of cooking. Despite her culinary talents, her family is against her desire to pursue a career in the culinary 
arts, due to the plebeian association with the practice.

Saki is also rather prideful and hot tempered, when it comes to social situations. Though extroverted, she isn’t the best at dealing with people and much prefers doing things her own way. She is easily flustered and struggles with putting on her kinder emotions, due to all 
the stresses put on her, by her family

She is the first love interest of this story and one whose path has much to unravel.
